instruction: An abstract parametric sculpture: a smooth polished (3,2) torus-knot ribbon looping through itself, mounted upright on a simple circular pedestal base. Mirror-polished metal with high metalness and low roughness so it reflects the environment, a single elegant mathematical form as a gallery piece.
